page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, in italic lines, with a catchword-like signature "G" below it and a catchword "Iam" at the right; a hyphenated split word "ca-/(rinas" at the right of one line, which is a marginal note on the right.

main_text.p: Ventorum posuit fragor, ac tumida vnda resedit, Et iam molle fretum Zephiri leuis innatat aura.

Obstupuere animis Indi. Tunc sydera Ductor Aspectans, tendensque manus. Tibi maxime ponti Rector (ait) Christe omnipotens nunc debita rursus Nostra salus; Tu nos tot per maria aspera tutos Aduehis huc, placidaque facis tellure potiri Tu modo praesenti seruas a funere classem, Perge precor, noftrosque iuues vbicumque iabores, Terrarum pelagique potens, atque aetheris auctor.
Haec (ait) & lacrimis oculos subfundit obortis, Amissosque animo Comites miseratur amico.
Continuo Canoas Indi insiluere cauatas, Auxilioque volant, classisque in tuta reducunt Fragmina, reliquias pelagi, clauosque, rudentesque, Instabilique legunt fluitantia marmore vela.

Dehinc Ductor quam speret opem, qua nam arte ca(rinas Iam laceras iterum intexat, sub pectore voluit Tristis, & ardenti curarum fluctuat vnda. Ostendit fortuna viam. Prope littora surgit Ardua sylua ingens, montemque, & frondea late Arua tenet, hanc immisso procumbere ferro Imperat, inde legi reparandae accommoda classi Robora, iam sumptis exercitus omnis in armis Imperium Ducis exequitur, coeloque minantes Deturbant terrae pinus, iam quercus, & albens Populus, ingentemque abies dedit icta ruinam,

page.notes: The running text is set in italic type. The right-margin note "(rinas" completes the hyphenated word "ca-rinas". The signature "G" and catchword "Iam" are at the foot. Some letters in the Greek-like ampersand forms are rendered as &. Page number not printed.
